login.title: Sign in
login.description: Administrator, company, merchant and beneficiary spaces.
login.invalidMessage: Check what you typed. After 5 attempts, sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes. If you forgot it, use “Forgot your password?”.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes (10 characters).
mfa.lostDevice: Lost your phone and no recovery code left? Contact your organisation administrator, who can reset your two-step verification.

firstLogin.title: Choose your password
firstLogin.description: Your temporary password must be replaced before you can open your space.
firstLogin.deadline: You have until {time} to choose your password.
firstLogin.deadlineSoon: Less than 2 minutes left: save your new password before {time}.
firstLogin.windowExpired: The time to choose your password is over. Sign in again with your temporary password to start over.

password.notCompromised: Not a password known to have leaked
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.policyError: This password does not follow the rules below.

enroll.title: Turn on two-step verification
enroll.description: It protects your account even if your password is found out.
enroll.step1: 1. Install an authenticator app on your phone.
enroll.appsExample: An authenticator app shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds. Examples: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or FreeOTP.
enroll.step2: 2. Add your FlexiPay account by entering this key in the app.
enroll.keyHint: Choose “Enter a setup key” in the app. Never share this key.
enroll.step3: 3. Enter the code shown in the app.

recovery.title: Your recovery codes
recovery.description: Each one lets you sign in once if you no longer have your phone.
recovery.warning: These codes will not be shown again. Write them down and keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
recovery.noted: I have written down my recovery codes

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.description: Enter your e-mail or phone. You will receive a link (valid for 15 minutes) or a text message code.
forgot.sentMessage: If an account matches, a link valid for 15 minutes has just been sent (or a text message code). Remember to check your spam folder.

reset.title: New password
reset.description: Choose a new password. Your two-step verification stays on.
reset.doneMessage: You can sign in with your new password. Your other sessions have been closed.
reset.invalidMessage: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.message: To protect your account, you were signed out after a period of inactivity.

ticket.label: Sign-in voucher
ticket.title: The meal voucher,
ticket.lead: Meals, clothing, fuel, gifts: your credits are waiting on the other side of this voucher.
ticket.fact: Your credits are available as soon as your employer validates them.
